causalFinding: Both exact current mutations bypass the not-started rejection in Collect. The receiving test awaits Assert.ThrowsAsync on CollectAsync without an outer bound before it calls StartAsync. A returned pending collection task can therefore prevent the assertion from returning and prevent scope cleanup from starting. RunnerScope.DisposeAsync itself is already bounded at lines658-664.
proposedLaterReceivingCorrection: Bound the assertion task externally and retain a genuine TimeoutException if it fails to settle. Do not place the watchdog inside Assert.ThrowsAsync, which could reclassify timeout as a direct assertion. Any actual pending collection and cleanup still require honest bounded drainage.
